aria: Quick heads-up: EU micro-canary planned Thu 09:30 UTC. Need a short release-note snippet + internal announce. Pin: v3.0.0-q, fallback v2.9.8. Who can draft? @tom @jen
tom: I can take the blurb. Keep it punchy (<40 words). Canary SLOs: p95 <=110ms, errors <0.4%. What are hard rollback triggers?
jen: Rollback triggers: 1) error rate >0.7% for 3m continuous OR 2) eval drift >2% on the smoke set. Rollback steps: immediate pin to v2.9.8, scale down new instances, escalate to oncall and post in #incidents.
nina: deploy-bot queued job id db-9001 by @aria. Command:
```
/deploy canary --model v3.0.0-q --region eu --window 30m --notify #eng-oncall
```
ops-bot: preflight checklist reminder: smoke scripts uploaded, monitoring dashboard linked, rate limiter rules validated. See: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-canary
aria: tagging @jen for rollback wording and @tom for the copy. Also embargo until 10:45 UTC to give us warmup. Need owner for the first 45m.
tom: Draft internal blurb:
"INTERNAL: EU canary for v3.0.0-q — Thu 09:30 UTC. Owner: @jen. Fallback: v2.9.8. Targets: p95 <=110ms, errors <0.4%. Embargo until 10:45 UTC. On breach -> immediate pin & rollback. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-canary"
jen: small tweak: change owner to @nina (she's oncall then) and note automatic metric gating: deploy-bot will pause if p95 exceeds 150ms.
aria: perfect. approvals?
tom: +1 :thumbsup:
jen: +1
nina: I'll own the 09:30-11:00 window. I'll run the smoke eval at T+5 and T+20. Smoke script: https://git.company/redwood/evals/eu-smoke-runner
deploy-bot: job db-9001 state -> ready. Will execute on /deploy start. :robot_face:
aria: final copy I'll paste into #internal-announce 15m before deploy. Will pin in #eng-releases as well. Closing thread — thanks all. :rocket:
